Brand Introduction:

Designed for individuals with high health awareness and those battling health issues such as obesity, diabetes, and hypertension, Beebird Technology products facilitate the easy tracking of health data and support lifestyle changes from home. Managed through a single application, our devices and their smart analysis features allow users to continuously monitor and manage their health status. Our AI-supported mobile application offers personalized nutrition and exercise recommendations based on the user's health profile, making it easier for users to make healthy choices.

Product Description:

The Beebird Smart Kitchen Scale is an innovative kitchen tool that will guide you on your journey to a healthier life. This smart scale, with its advanced sensors and comprehensive nutrition database, transforms your kitchen experience. It enables users to accurately measure the weight of foods and also calculates the calorie, protein, fat, and other nutritional values of consumed foods with precision. Essential for healthy eating and diet planning, the Beebird Smart Kitchen Scale helps you understand the nutritional value of foods and better manage your daily intake. The scale easily connects to your smartphone or tablet via Bluetooth. Through the Beebird Home application, you can track the nutritional values and measurements, thus providing the motivation and information needed to achieve your health and nutrition goals. With its sleek and modern design, the Beebird Smart Kitchen Scale, made with high-quality materials, stands out in any kitchen.

USP (Unique Selling Point): Beebird home website

Payment Terms:

Within our program, we offer a 10% commission for every sale of our products, valued at 650 TL. Commission payments will be made on the last working day of each month. This means that the commissions earned within the month will accumulate and be paid out in a lump sum at the end of the month. Commission payments will be made via bank transfer. To ensure timely and accurate payments, participants must provide their bank account information correctly and completely upon registering for our program.
